title: Declined Renewal Fees, Payment Hold and Lapse
content:
Billing operations standard of Northgate Rewards and Northgate+ Memberships for a renewal fee that does not settle.

**Placement on hold.** When the scheduled renewal attempt (attempt number 0) is declined, the membership moves to payment hold on that date, which is recorded as the payment hold date. Automatic retries run every retry interval of calendar days after the decline, up to the tier's number of retries, each declined retry being recorded with the next attempt number. The declines in a hold are counted per billing period: the number of declined attempts on the membership that carry the start date of the billing period whose renewal fee was declined. The member may also update the payment method and have the outstanding fee charged at once.

**During the hold.** Paid benefits do not apply while the membership is on payment hold, and orders placed during the hold are charged the fees a non-member pays. A membership on payment hold cannot be scheduled for cancellation; it either clears or lapses.

**Clearing — time gate.** A payment hold can be cleared only on or before the payment hold date plus the tier's payment hold grace days. Calendar days are added to the payment hold date, the day after the decline being day 1, and settlement on the last day of the grace period still clears the hold. When the outstanding fee settles the membership returns to active and the renewal date is counted from the declined billing period start, not from the settlement date, so the member does not gain extra days.

**Lapse.** A membership still unpaid after the last day of the grace period lapses to canceled on the following day; no fee is owed for the unpaid period and the lapse is never reported as a member-initiated cancellation.

**Boundary cases (hypothetical 10-day grace period, payment hold date 5 June 2031)**

| Date the outstanding fee settles | Result |
|---|---|
| 15 June 2031 (last day of the grace period) | hold cleared, membership active again |
| not settled by 15 June 2031 | membership lapses to canceled on 16 June 2031, no fee owed for the unpaid period |

**Renewal date after clearing (hypothetical monthly tier).** A renewal declined for the billing period starting 5 June 2031 and settled on 9 June 2031 leaves the next renewal date on 5 July 2031, counted from 5 June, not from 9 June.
